note: DA-08: governed tenant knowledge, including each tenant's append-only information-asset ledger (knowledge/confidential/{tenant}/_ledger/assets.jsonl, DA-05) — NEVER auto-deletable. Removal happens only through the audited tenant offboarding ceremony (scope-offboarding.ts, `pnpm kyberion offboard tenant <slug> --execute --preview-id <id> --approved-by <actor> --purpose <reason>`), which exports before purging. Declared so the ledger's retention decision is explicit rather than silently uncovered. WI-10: this prefix also covers each tenant's promoted work-inventory records (knowledge/confidential/{tenant}/work-inventory/entries/*.json, calibration.json, work-inventory.ts) — same never-auto-delete, offboarding-only-removal semantics; declared here rather than as a separate entry because the tenant slug is a variable path segment this catalog's prefix matching already spans.
